style: Premium stylised-realistic 2.5D sports-hero look, in the spirit of EA FC Mobile and Cricket League: chunky confident silhouettes with slightly oversized heads, hands and feet, athletic proportions, and warm expressive faces. Rendering is clean soft-gradient cel shading: two to three tonal steps per surface, a crisp rim light in warm gold on the key side and a cool indigo bounce on the shadow side, and a thin dark-indigo outline (2-3 px at 1080p) that thickens at the silhouette. Materials are readable at thumbnail size: matte mud-brown and sand mats with fine grain, glossy lacquered synthetic mats with soft specular streaks, satin jersey fabric with subtle fold highlights, polished brushed-gold trim, and frosted glass HUD panels with an inner glow. Lighting is dramatic stadium floodlighting from above-front, with volumetric light shafts, soft bloom on gold and neon, and a gentle vignette. The mat is the brightest, cleanest area, with a clear value hierarchy: mat and players first, HUD second, crowd last. The crowd is blurred, desaturated and low-contrast, and sits in a parallax far layer with depth haze. The mood is electric, proud and festive: a night-match arena in saturated indigo and royal blue, hot saffron and gold, and a punchy crimson accent. Ghost mechanics use a translucent cyan-violet holographic trail with scanline shimmer and soft additive glow, clearly distinct from real players. There is no gore and no violence; contact reads as athletic, with dust puffs and impact starbursts. Detailing stays uncluttered, with no text baked into images and no real brands.
